speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) whether the Ministry is considering new measures to further support small businesses, especially stallholders at markets and food centres in the heartlands, beyond the existing rent stabilisation measures and financial grants; and (b) if so, what are these measures.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I was wondering whether MSE has got feedback about the Community Development Council (CDC) Vouchers from merchants and hawkers, and whether it is a multiplier effect to generate business in the heartlands?

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: And if so, would they support the additional provision of CDC Vouchers from your Ministry's point of view?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: But just from anecdotal experience, even from within my own constituency, I do see that quite a number of residents spend their vouchers at many of our hawker stalls.
